cues: Here are the six results the syllabus expects you to know.
A thin rod: one twelfth M L squared about its centre, one third M L squared about one end.
A disc or solid cylinder: one half M R squared.
A solid sphere: two fifths M R squared.
And a hollow sphere: two thirds M R squared.
